title: Title-Delay Chargebacks on Trade-In Agreements
content:
When Kestrel still holds no transferable title for a vehicle traded under **Trade-In Agreements** long after pickup, the trade value may be charged back.

## Rule

A title-delay chargeback may be taken only after the title delay chargeback days counted from the pickup date have passed with no title received date. The chargeback period is counted in calendar days with the pickup date as day 0 and the chargeback is allowed from the day after its last day. It is booked on the picked-up trade-in agreement as one value deduction entry for the title-delay chargeback, dated the day it is booked, and it lowers the undistributed trade equity by its amount.

The pickup date and the title received date are read from the agreement.

## The period at its boundary

With the grade's title delay chargeback days written as D:

| Day counted from the pickup date (day 0) | Title received date on the agreement | Chargeback allowed? |
|---|---|---|
| Day D | None | No; the period has not yet passed |
| Day D plus one | None | Yes |
| Day D plus one | Recorded | No |

## Business effect

| Item | Effect |
|---|---|
| Agreement history | One value deduction entry with the reason title-delay chargeback, dated the booking day |
| Undistributed trade equity | Lower by the chargeback; a balance below zero is a shortfall the customer owes |

## Care console reference: `post_title_delay_chargeback_a143df45`

**Capability.** Posts a title-delay chargeback against the trade value of one picked-up trade-in vehicle whose transferable title has not been received. One call books one deduction entry of the reason `title_delay_chargeback`, dated today, for the amount given and lowers the agreement's undistributed trade equity by that same amount; the entry shows in the agreement's history, and a balance below zero is a shortfall the customer owes.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, naming `post_title_delay_chargeback_a143df45`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `trade_in_id` | Reference number of the customer's trade-in agreement, as shown by the trade-in agreement lookup for this customer | Id |
| `chargeback_amount` | The chargeback to book | USD, a positive amount to 2 decimal places (rounded to the nearest cent) |

**Return.** A text rendering of a receipt with `entry_id` (reference number of the new chargeback entry), `trade_in_id`, `adjustment_type` (always `title_delay_chargeback`), `amount` (USD to 2 decimal places, the chargeback booked), `posted_on` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `equity_balance` (USD to 2 decimal places, the undistributed trade equity with the chargeback booked; negative means the customer owes a shortfall). A receipt carrying an `entry_id` means the chargeback is booked.
